newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Bank Queensland safe in merger - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Bank Queensland safe in merger - paper.

text.p: The Queensland government's 44 percent stake in the Bank of Queensland Ltd would not be absorbed as part of the planned merger between Metway Bank Ltd, Suncorp Insurance and Finance, and Queensland Industry Development Corp (QIDC), a Courier-Mail newspaper report said.

The report quoted Queensland premier Rob Borbidge as saying the government had given a new undertaking that it would not deal with the Bank of Queensland holding, except under a takeover bid or a scheme of arrangement approved by Bank of Queensland shareholders.
The latest undertaking from the government follows a decision by the Reserve Bank to give the government three years to deal with the Bank of Queensland stake, the newspaper said.
Meanwhile, the Bank of Queensland stake had been moved from its Suncorp owner to a Queensland Treasury company as part of the merger arrangements, the newspaper said.
The new undertaking ensures the shares cannot be transferred from the new owner, Queensland Treasury Holdings Ltd, without prior approval, it said.
The newspaper also said that Borbidge has yet to officially respond to a Bank of Queensland proposal to buy back 30 per cent of the company at current market prices.
Bank of Queensland chairman, Neil Roberts told Reuters in an interview this week that offer was still current.
